description: form.rs module-level doc explains that all ParseError instances from this module set line=0 col=0 because Token carries no source position. This is documented, pinned by a test (structural_parse_error_location_is_zero), and accepted as a known limitation. The issue is a reminder that when Token is extended with source position, form.rs must be updated to plumb those positions through. The test pin is a good forward-safety mechanism.
title: auth: form.rs parse errors report location (0,0); structural errors have no source position
